integrity: Exact finite-field determinant and Fitting proofs; self-contained matrix and polynomial certificate scripts reproduced. All universal statements rest on proof rather than finite experiments.
scientific_limitations: Only 3-by-(2^b-1) zero-boundary grids with \(b\ge3\) and one corner self-feedback; characteristic-two fields. The two maximal primitive-cycle instances are \(b=3\) and \(b=5\); no all-b primitive claim. No full first-entry transient histogram. Historical priority uncertain for uncatalogued 2D hybrid automata.
title: A single corner feedback bit creates maximal-length cycles on rectangular parity grids
